data.text: Should night-bus route NB-7 keep its 2 a.m. run through March?
data.why: The question this judgment trail answers, recorded as the user's question rather than a finding.

data.text: The March timetable decision needs a keep-or-cut answer for the NB-7 2 a.m. run.
data.scope: Use purpose stated by the user for this judgment only.
data.why: Records why the conclusion mattered, so later reuse can check whether the purpose still fits.

data.text: An answer counts as sufficient for the March decision when January ridership and January operating cost for the 2 a.m. run are both on record.
data.scope: The user's stated sufficiency criterion for this decision only; not a universal proof threshold.
data.why: Pins what 'enough to decide' meant at judgment time, as the user's attributed judgment.

data.text: Keep the NB-7 2 a.m. run through March, provided February ridership stays above 12 riders per run.
data.scope: Conditional: applies only while the February average stays above 12 riders per run. Only January figures are on record (evd_jt_riders_jan, evd_jt_cost_jan). Judgment recorded in capture req_jt_conditional_v1.
data.why: Answers clm_jt_question for the purpose in clm_jt_purpose; meets the sufficiency criterion in clm_jt_sufficient because both January figures are on record.

data.rationale: The January average of 14 supports the keep side of the conclusion as baseline demand; it does not satisfy the February condition, which remains unchecked (see clm_jt_reservation_feb).
January cost is on record but no cost ceiling was stated, so cost limits rather than settles the conclusion.

data.text: February ridership and cost are not on record, so the February condition is unchecked and the conclusion may not hold.
data.scope: Reservation on clm_jt_conditional; unresolved at judgment time.
data.why: Keeps the open condition visible on recall instead of letting the conclusion read as unconditional.

data.rationale: Unresolved objection: the February condition has no grounding passage yet.

data.text: A ledger search for February NB-7 figures returned no hits; this is absence of record, not proof that no counterevidence exists.
data.scope: Search-scope note for this judgment only; covers the ledger searched, not the world.
data.why: Prevents a later reader from relabeling missing hits as proof of no counterevidence.

data.rationale: The conclusion rests on January figures plus an unchecked February condition; the empty February search is a limit, not support.
